test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the given sentence.

Both songs have been reworked giving them fresh __impetus.__
solution:
The correct answer is **Incitement.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the given sentence is Incitement.
 
• Incitement is the act of inciting illegal behaviour or pushing someone to engage in illegal behaviour
 
• Impetus means the energy or power with which a body moves
 
• Thus the correct synonym is incitement.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **D****etachment **means **the state of being objective or aloof.**
 
• **Aversion** means **a strong dislike or aversion.**
 
• **Disfavour **means **dislike or disapproval.**
